ui.tagline: Vietnamese noodle bar in Buena Park and Irvine
ui.avoidHint: Tap an allergen to flag every dish that contains it.
ui.legendLikely: Usual for this preparation. Ask your server to confirm.
ui.refillsNote: Free refills on drinks marked with the refill tag.
ui.lunchWhen: Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 4 PM
ui.lunchTerms: Dine-in only, excluding holidays. Valid at all SUP Noodle Bar locations. Add-ons and extras cost extra. Limited time only.
ui.kimchiSub: With Spam, soft tofu, or filet mignon
ui.allergyNotice: Please tell your server about any dietary restrictions or food allergies. We strongly advise guests with severe food allergies or sensitivities to exercise caution when dining at SUP. We make every effort to accommodate food allergies and keep our guests safe, but cross-contamination is always possible and we cannot guarantee an allergen-free environment. If you have any questions, please ask your server.
ui.halalNote: SUP Noodle Bar does not claim that any of its food is halal.
ui.rawNotice: Dishes prepared with soft-boiled, poached, sunny-side-up, or over-easy eggs, as well as rare or medium-rare steaks, may be undercooked. These items may be served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions.
ui.phoRefill: Free unlimited noodle refills with dine-in pho.

sec.pho.title: Pho
sec.pho.intro: Thin rice noodles served in beef bone broth, garnished with white onions, scallions, and cilantro. Free unlimited noodle refills with dine-in pho.
sec.pho.brothNote: Every pho, including the veggie and tofu bowl, is made with beef bone broth.

item.bao.name: Golden Bao
item.bao.desc: Ground pork shoulder, caramelized onions, mushrooms, and a hard-boiled egg, wrapped in homemade dough and fried to a crisp.
item.springroll.name: Spring Roll
item.springroll.desc: Fresh bean sprouts, mint, lettuce, and vermicelli wrapped in rice paper. Served with peanut sauce.
item.eggrolls.name: Egg Rolls
item.eggrolls.desc: Ground pork, mushrooms, onions, carrots, and glass noodles, deep-fried until crispy. Served with pickled carrots, vermicelli, lettuce, and sweet and sour fish sauce.
item.shakenfries.name: Shaken House Fries
item.shakenfries.desc: Colossal crisp fries topped with shaken beef belly, garlic, caramelized onions, sharp cheddar cheese, and spicy tartar sauce.
item.trufflefries.name: Truffle Fries
item.trufflefries.desc: Colossal crisp fries tossed with fresh herbs, parmesan cheese, and Italian truffle oil. Served with spicy aji verde aioli, ketchup, and spicy mayo.
item.parmfries.name: Parmesan Fries
item.parmfries.desc: Colossal crisp fries tossed in fresh herbs and garlic, topped with parmesan cheese. Served with spicy aji verde aioli, ketchup, and spicy mayo.
item.wings.name: Chicken Wings
item.wings.desc: Crispy fried chicken wings, your choice of garlic or parmesan.
item.nuggets.name: Chicken Nugget Basket
item.nuggets.desc: Crispy nuggets with colossal crisp fries, ketchup, and spicy mayo.
item.phoshortrib.name: Pho Short Rib
item.phoshortrib.desc: Thinly sliced boneless short rib, rich in flavor and melt-in-your-mouth tender.
item.phoribbones.name: Pho Rib Bones
item.phoribbones.desc: Fall-off-the-bone beef ribs, braised for four hours for a deep, hearty flavor.
item.phobeefbelly.name: Pho Beef Belly
item.phobeefbelly.note: Weekday lunch special: $11.99, dine-in only, 10 AM to 4 PM.
item.phofilet.name: Pho Filet Mignon
item.phofilet.desc: Lean filet mignon, tender and flavorful.
item.phocombo.name: Pho Combination
item.phocombo.desc: A mix of beef belly, tendon, brisket, meatball, and one rib bone.
item.phoveggie.name: Pho Veggie and Tofu
item.phoveggie.desc: Tofu, broccoli, carrots, and napa cabbage in a rich beef broth.
item.phoveggie.note: Made with beef broth, so this bowl is not vegetarian.
item.phobrisket.name: Pho Brisket
item.phobrisket.desc: Four-hour-braised brisket, tender with a slight chew.
item.phoshrimp.name: Pho Shrimp
item.phoshrimp.desc: Large poached shrimp, light and fresh.
item.phomeatballs.name: Pho Meatballs
item.phobourdain.name: Pho Anthony Bourdain
item.phobourdain.desc: Wok-seared scallions, red onions, and minced garlic with filet mignon and flat noodles. Smoky and packed with flavor.
item.drynoodle.name: Beef Belly Dry Noodle
item.drynoodle.desc: Stir-fried beef belly in lemongrass sauce, served over fresh spring mix, vegetables, and flat noodles. Garnished with roasted peanuts, fried shallots, and fresh herbs. Served dry, without soup.
addon.shaken.name: Make your pho shaken style
addon.shaken.desc: Wok-seared garlic, scallions, and red onions in bone marrow oil. Adds a depth of smokiness for a distinct northern-style flavor.
addon.sousvide.name: Add a sous vide egg
addon.sousvide.desc: Slow-poached egg that adds a milky richness to your broth.
addon.mala.name: Add a numbing sensation
addon.spicy.name: Make your pho spicy
item.lomo.name: Lomo Saltado
item.lomo.desc: Thick-cut fries, charred sweet red onions, tomatoes, and white wine soy with your choice of protein and steamed white rice. Served with house-made spicy aji verde aioli.
item.lomo.note: The aji verde aioli contains egg and Parmesan cheese, so the aji verde aioli sauce is not vegan.
addon.lomofriedegg.name: Fried egg
addon.lomosoftegg.name: Soft-boiled egg
item.cajun.name: Cajun Garlic Noodles
item.cajun.desc: Wheat noodles tossed in butter and Cajun garlic sauce, finished with fresh scallions. Served with house-made spicy aji verde aioli.
item.cajun.note: The shrimp and sausage plate contains shellfish.
item.friedrice.name: Fried Rice
item.friedrice.desc: Your choice of protein with scrambled eggs and scallions. Served with house-made spicy aji verde aioli on the side.
item.friedrice.note: The shrimp plate contains shellfish. Tofu plates contain soy. Chicken wings are breaded with wheat.
item.kimchi.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
item.kimchi.desc: The house fried rice tossed with kimchi, with scrambled eggs and scallions. Served with house-made spicy aji verde aioli on the side.
item.kimchi.note: Kimchi is usually fermented with fish sauce and salted shrimp. The soft tofu plate contains soy.

item.kidsbox.name: Kids Meal Box
item.kidsbox.desc: Crispy golden chicken nuggets and seasoned fries, with a juice box to complete the meal.

item.herbaltea.name: Herbal Iced Tea
item.herbaltea.desc: A blend of pandan and artichoke.
item.thaitea.name: Thai Iced Tea
item.thaitea.desc: Sweet and creamy with strong black tea notes.
item.lychee.name: Lychee Lemonade or Soda
item.lychee.desc: Blended lychee with lemonade or soda.
